items.title: Polite noun past
items.explanation: 水です becomes 水でした. Contrast い-adjective かったです and verb ました.

items.title: に for the writing surface
items.pattern: surface に 文/字 を 書きます
items.explanation: The surface receiving writing uses に; the object uses を and the activity's place uses で.

items.title: Broad times of day
items.explanation: The main routine models use bare broad times, unlike clock time に. This is a default model, not a ban on context-dependent 朝に/夜に.

items.title: Frequency words
items.pattern: 毎日 / いつも / 時々 + action
items.explanation: Every day, always/usually and sometimes describe recurrence. The ordinary 毎日 model has no に; 時々 is a whole word with an iteration mark.

items.title: Already completed
items.explanation: もう本を読みました states completed reading by now. It does not merely state frequency.

items.title: Not yet: the taught reply
items.pattern: もう…ましたか。→ いいえ、まだです。
items.explanation: The reply means not yet for the queried action. Fuller ていません completion grammar is left for later.
